work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act XIV has synopsis 15023–15026, protocol 15028–15029 and complete sections 1–19 through original dating 15591–15593 and editorial dating 15595. Retains historical notes/corrections at 15059–15070, 15127–15133, 15203, 15315, 15368–15371, 15431, 15493–15495 and 15554. The correction at 15610 is displaced below the next act XV heading and opening: its corrected possessive corresponds to the marked word at 15580 in XIV, not the unmarked opening of XV at 15606–15608. Appends only 15610 as a source-proved disjoint apparatus range. The entire added note and 20 lines on either side have also been inspected. Substantive-extent re-audit: All nineteen sections of the present indulgence and faculties grant are printed, including the operative grants and their conditions; references to antecedent grants remain part of the present text.
